classification.difficultyReason: Uses equality of opposite directed sides of a parallelogram to determine two unknown coordinates.

content.prompt:
The parallelogram $WXYZ$ has vertices $W(-6,4)$, $X(6,2)$, $Y(4,9)$ and $Z(a,b)$.
Use vectors to find the values of $a$ and $b$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\overrightarrow{WZ}&=\overrightarrow{OZ}-\overrightarrow{OW}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}a-(-6)\\b-4\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}a+6\\b-4\end{pmatrix}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\overrightarrow{XY}&=\overrightarrow{OY}-\overrightarrow{OX}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}4-6\\9-2\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}-2\\7\end{pmatrix}\end{align*}$$
Opposite sides of the parallelogram have equal vectors in these directions.
$$\begin{align*}\overrightarrow{WZ}&=\overrightarrow{XY}\\\begin{pmatrix}a+6\\b-4\end{pmatrix}&=\begin{pmatrix}-2\\7\end{pmatrix}\\a+6&=-2\\a&=-8\\b-4&=7\\b&=11\end{align*}$$
